methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing for leading video-conferencing platforms was collected from each vendor's official pricing page (or a reputable 2026 aggregator page when the official page returned 403/JS-only) on 2026-06-14 and normalized to USD. Where a vendor prices per seat, monthlyUsd records the per-seat list price at the annual-billing rate (consistent with how pricing is most commonly advertised); the month-to-month rate is noted in plan notes when both were observed. Quote-only / contact-sales tiers carry monthlyUsd = null rather than an estimate. Whereby's Pro tier is flat-rate (single host) while its Business tier is priced per host (3-host minimum); GoTo Meeting is priced per organizer. These are non-telephony video-conferencing products, so minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, and overagePerCall are null on every plan. hipaa/baa/bilingual are null unless a vendor explicitly states compliance on the pricing page. Zoom's official pricing page rendered JS-only (no prices extracted); USD figures from GetApp (last updated March 2026) and corroborated by softwareadvice.com. Google Workspace official page geo-resolved to EUR; USD rates confirmed via workspace.google.com with gl=US query parameter and corroborated by GetApp (March 2026). GoTo Meeting and Webex official pages returned HTTP 403; figures from GetApp (last updated June 2026) corroborated by softwareadvice.com and costbench.com (Webex Suite Business confirmed at $22.50/user/mo annual, $27 month-to-month, 17% annual discount). Microsoft Teams prices fetched directly from microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-teams/compare-microsoft-teams-options and corroborated by GetApp.

vendors.name: Zoom
vendors.provenance: Official zoom.us/pricing page rendered JS-only with no extractable prices. USD plan prices sourced from GetApp (last updated March 2026) and corroborated by softwareadvice.com Zoom profile. Monthly billing rates ($16.99/$21.99) from TechRepublic Sep 2025; annual rates ($13.33/$18.33) consistent with those sources. GetApp March 2026 lists $14.99/19.99 as the displayed per-user monthly rate; used as the annual-equivalent rate.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Free forever. Up to 100 participants, 40-minute limit on group meetings, unlimited 1:1 meetings (up to 30 hours), whiteboard, private and group chat.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $13.33/user/mo billed annually; month-to-month rate $16.99/user/mo per TechRepublic Sep 2025 review. GetApp March 2026 lists $14.99/user/mo (likely annualized display). Includes 1 GB cloud recording/license, 30-hour group meetings, up to 100 participants (expandable to 1,000 with add-on), social media streaming.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $18.33/user/mo billed annually; month-to-month rate $21.99/user/mo per TechRepublic Sep 2025 review. GetApp March 2026 lists $19.99/user/mo. Includes up to 300 participants (expandable to 1,000 with add-on), company branding, managed domains, single sign-on.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales / custom pricing. Unlimited cloud storage, up to 500 participants (expandable to 1,000 with add-on), dedicated customer success manager, executive business reviews.

vendors.name: Google Meet
vendors.provenance: Official workspace.google.com/pricing page geo-resolved to EUR. USD rates obtained via workspace.google.com/pricing?hl=en&gl=US confirming Starter $7, Standard $14, Plus $22 per user/month. Corroborated by GetApp (last updated March 2026) listing identical USD per-user monthly rates. 16% annual discount confirmed on the official page. Enterprise requires sales contact.

plans.name: Business Starter
plans.notes: $7.00/user/mo on an annual commitment (flexible month-to-month rate is higher, ~$8.40/user/mo). monthlyUsd records the annual-billing rate, consistent with this catalog's convention. Includes Google Meet video calling up to 100 participants, 30 GB pooled storage per user, Gmail, Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Slides.

plans.name: Business Standard
plans.notes: $14.00/user/mo on an annual commitment (flexible month-to-month rate is higher, ~$16.80/user/mo). monthlyUsd records the annual-billing rate. Google Meet up to 150 participants, meeting recording to Drive, noise cancellation, 2 TB pooled storage per user.

plans.name: Business Plus
plans.notes: $22.00/user/mo on an annual commitment (flexible month-to-month rate is higher, ~$26.40/user/mo). monthlyUsd records the annual-billing rate. Google Meet up to 500 participants, attendance tracking, eDiscovery/audit, 5 TB pooled storage per user, enhanced security controls.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Google Meet up to 1,000 participants (livestream up to 100,000), advanced security and compliance, data loss prevention, Vault, enhanced support. No user limit.

vendors.name: Webex
vendors.provenance: Official webex.com/pricing page returned HTTP 403. USD plan prices sourced from GetApp (last updated June 2026) and corroborated by softwareadvice.com Webex profile. Annual billing rate for Meet ($12/user/mo) from TechRepublic Sep 2025 review; monthly billing rate ($14.50) consistent across GetApp and softwareadvice.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free forever. HD meetings up to 100 participants, 40-minute meeting limit, screen sharing, unlimited whiteboards, local recording.

plans.name: Meet
plans.notes: $12.00/user/mo billed annually per TechRepublic Sep 2025 review; month-to-month rate $14.50/user/mo per GetApp June 2026. Up to 200 participants, breakout rooms, cloud recording, screen sharing, noise removal, closed captions.

plans.name: Suite Business
plans.notes: $22.50/user/mo billed annually (17% off the month-to-month rate of $27.00/user/mo), confirmed via costbench.com Webex profile (June 2026). Includes cloud phone number per license, phone menus/extensions, HD meetings up to 200 participants, cloud recording, AI Assistant.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Up to 1,000 meeting attendees, FedRAMP security, simultaneous interpretation, call barging, cloud recording, all premium features.

vendors.name: Microsoft Teams
vendors.provenance: Prices read directly from microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-teams/compare-microsoft-teams-options on 2026-06-14. All prices are per user per month billed annually. Corroborated by GetApp Microsoft Teams pricing page.

plans.name: Teams Free
plans.notes: Free for individuals. Unlimited group meetings up to 30 hours, up to 100 participants, 5 GB OneDrive storage, unlimited chat.

plans.name: Teams Essentials
plans.notes: $4.00/user/mo paid yearly. Unlimited group meetings up to 30 hours, up to 300 participants, meeting recordings with transcripts, 1 TB OneDrive storage per user.

plans.name: Microsoft 365 Business Basic
plans.notes: $6.00/user/mo paid yearly. Includes Teams plus web and mobile versions of Office apps, 1 TB OneDrive storage, Exchange email, SharePoint, Microsoft Loop.

plans.name: Microsoft 365 Business Standard
plans.notes: $12.50/user/mo paid yearly. Includes Teams plus full desktop Office apps (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook), webinar hosting, attendee registration, 1 TB OneDrive storage per user.

vendors.name: Whereby
vendors.provenance: Verified 2026-06-14 against the official whereby.com/information/meetings/select-plan page, which now renders current USD plan prices, and corroborated by costbench.com Whereby profile. Whereby's Pro tier is a flat-rate single-host plan; the Business tier is priced per host (3-host minimum). Prior figures ($6.99 Pro, $29.97 Business, 45-min/100-participant Free) were stale/unconfirmable and have been corrected to the published 2026 rates.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free forever. 1 host, 1 room URL, 30-minute meeting limit, up to 4 attendees per meeting (per official select-plan page, June 2026).

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $10.99/mo flat rate (1 host, not per user). 3 room URLs, up to 100 attendees per meeting, unlimited meeting duration, custom branding, unlimited recording. Confirmed on official select-plan page, June 2026.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $13.99/mo per host, 3-host minimum (so an effective floor of ~$41.97/mo). Unlimited room URLs, up to 200 attendees per meeting, shared/Flex rooms, custom subdomain. monthlyUsd records the per-host list price; billingModel is per_seat (per host). Confirmed on official select-plan page, June 2026.

vendors.name: GoTo Meeting
vendors.provenance: Official goto.com/meeting/pricing returned HTTP 403. USD plan prices sourced from GetApp (last updated June 2026) showing monthly billing rates ($14/$19 per organizer) and FAQ annual rates ($12/$16 per organizer/month billed annually). Corroborated by softwareadvice.com GoTo Meeting profile. Enterprise is contact-sales only.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: $12.00/organizer/mo billed annually; month-to-month rate $14.00/organizer/mo. Up to 150 participants, breakout rooms, dial-in conference line, HD video, screen sharing, unlimited meetings, web audio. Priced per organizer, not per attendee.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $16.00/organizer/mo billed annually; month-to-month rate $19.00/organizer/mo. Up to 250 participants, drawing tools, slide-to-PDF, smart meeting assistant, unlimited cloud recording, all Professional features. Priced per organizer.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Volume discounts, dedicated customer success manager, onboarding and training, in-room link support, custom contract.

vendors.name: RingCentral
vendors.provenance: USD plan prices sourced from GetApp RingEX pricing page (last updated June 2026). Official ringcentral.com/office/plansandpricing.html required user interaction (seat count selector) to render plan prices; base prices not extractable. GetApp shows monthly billing rates for Core/Advanced/Ultra. Annual discount (up to 33%) mentioned on official page; specific annual per-tier rates not available in extracted content so annualDiscountPct recorded as null for individual plans.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: $30.00/user/mo (monthly billing per GetApp June 2026). RingCentral site states 'save up to 33% by paying annually'; exact annual rate not confirmed per tier. Includes HD video meetings, unlimited domestic calling, SMS/MMS, IVR, Google and Microsoft app integrations, single sign-on, analytics.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: $35.00/user/mo (monthly billing per GetApp June 2026). Adds automatic call recording, advanced call monitoring, multi-site management, 300+ app integrations, internet fax, business analytics.

plans.name: Ultra
plans.notes: $45.00/user/mo (monthly billing per GetApp June 2026). Adds unlimited video/messaging/file sharing, customizable business insights, expanded storage for recordings and files, enhanced analytics suite.
